title: Scientific Ontology (SO) / 存在境界論: Public Edition v4.1.0
description:
Scientific Ontology (SO) / 存在境界論 Public Edition v4.1.0 expands the public research and application layers established in v4.0.0.

This release introduces new Research Notes on AI adoption, History-Field Topology, and the Logical-depth Axis together with a new Applications layer for AI adoption. It preserves the existing publication policy, claim-strength management, terminology governance, and public/private boundary while extending the publicly discussable conceptual framework.

Scientific Ontology is a boundary-oriented conceptual framework for studying existence, history, communication, meaning, ethics, AI applications, and institutional interpretation through iterative publication, practical application, and conceptual refinement.
notes: This release expands the public research and application layers while preserving the publication policy, public/private boundary, terminology governance, and claim-strength management established in earlier public editions. Earlier releases remain archived within the Zenodo record family for historical continuity.
